item.title: Judge issues 14-day extension of order blocking Trump's memorial arch in DC
item.description: A federal judge has temporarily extended an order blocking the Trump administration from breaking ground on a towering memorial arch in the nation’s capital.

item.title: US military returns to 2 aircraft carriers in the Middle East
item.description: The U.S. military has gone back to having two aircraft carriers supporting Iran war operations after the USS George Washington departed the Middle East.

item.title: UK's Prince Harry sees 'big separation' between US administration, public on support for Ukraine
item.description: Britain’s Prince Harry offered a veiled criticism of the U.S. government’s policy toward Ukraine, saying in an interview released late Wednesday that he believes there is a “big separation” between the U.S. administration’s stance and that of the American people.

item.title: Campbell County blames meth, denies excessive force in fatal jail restraint lawsuit
item.description: In Campbell County’s first detailed response to allegations that county jail staff violated the civil rights of Kenneth Durrah, who died naked and strapped to a restraint chair, defense attorneys argued his death was “self-caused” by methamphetamine.

item.title: Florida pastor convicted of US charges related to assassination of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse
item.description: A Florida pastor with dual Haitian-American citizenship has been convicted of U.S. charges related to the 2021 assassination of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse.
